description.BLOCK: Bag with a rectangular block bottom — stands on its own; optionally with a handle.
description.FOLDED: Side-gusset bag with the bottom folded to the back (no block bottom, does not stand), e.g. for bread, fruit, sweets. No handles, 30–60 g/m² paper. Size written as W + F × H.

adjusted.intro: The configuration was adjusted to the “{{type}}” type:
adjusted.handle: removed the handle “{{handle}}” (not available for this type)
adjusted.moistureBarrier: moisture barrier switched off (not available for this type)
adjusted.pantoneColors: removed print colours above this type’s limit: {{removed}}
adjusted.extendToBottom: “Extend to bottom” switched off (the folded bottom strip is not printed)
adjusted.windowRemoved: window removed (not available for this type)
adjusted.windowConstrained: window fitted to the new dimensions

dimensions.label: Dimensions
dimensions.glueFlapInfo: Width of the longitudinal seam overlap: {{min}}–{{max}} mm, in 1 mm steps. Changes the blank width and the bag weight.
dimensions.bottomFoldInfo: Height of the bottom strip (fold + glue), folded to the back: {{min}}–{{max}} mm, in 1 mm steps. Changes the cut length L = H + d and the bag weight.

errors.NOT_ON_STEP: Value must be a multiple of {{step}} mm

standardSize.label: Standard size
standardSize.info: Catalogue sizes for the selected handle (W × D × H). Changing any dimension makes it a custom size.
standardSize.unavailableInfo: Greyed-out sizes exceed the current configurator limits:
standardSize.none: There are no standard sizes for the selected handle — enter custom dimensions.

warnings.BOTTOM_TRAPEZOID_DEGENERATE: Width below {{minWidth}} mm (depth + 30 mm): the front and back bottom flaps form a triangle instead of a trapezoid and the bottom sides overlap. Check feasibility with production.
warnings.GUSSET_OUTSIDE_RECOMMENDED: Gusset outside the recommended {{minGusset}}–{{maxGusset}} mm (0.4–0.7 × width). The maximum is the bag width.

errors.DEPTH_EXCEEDS_WIDTH: The gusset cannot be larger than the width

standardSize.none: Gusseted bags have no standard sizes — enter your own dimensions.

handle.label: Handle
handle.placementNote: Handles are glued to the inside of the front and back walls.

description.NONE: Classic block-bottom bag without a handle — the widest choice of papers and an optional moisture barrier.
description.FLAT_PAPER: Flat handle of strong, multi-folded kraft paper, glued inside and reinforced with a paper patch.
description.TWISTED_PAPER: Twisted handle of strong kraft paper, glued inside and reinforced with a paper patch.

adjusted.intro: The paper was adjusted to the selected handle:
adjusted.type: paper type: {{from}} → {{to}} (the previous one is not available with this handle)
adjusted.moistureBarrier: moisture barrier switched off (not available with this handle)

handle.noneAvailable: This bag type is made without handles.

description.NONE: Gusseted bag without a handle — kraft (white / brown), MG kraft, greaseproof or PE-coated paper, 30–60 g/m².

artwork.label: Artwork
artwork.choose: or click / press Enter to choose one
artwork.fillNote: Artwork is stretched over the whole panel.
artwork.aspectMismatch: The artwork's proportions ({{imageRatio}}) differ from the panel's ({{panelRatio}}) — the artwork will be distorted.

errors.UNSUPPORTED_TYPE: Unsupported file format. Allowed: PNG, JPG, WEBP.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large (max. {{maxMb}} MB).
errors.DECODE_FAILED: The file could not be read as an image.

artwork.aspectMismatchWrap: The artwork's aspect ratio ({{imageRatio}}) differs from that of the walls around the bag ({{panelRatio}}) — with “Stretch” the artwork will be distorted.

layout.label: Artwork layout
layout.wrapNote: The artwork runs around the bag: {{order}} — in dieline order, starting at the left edge of the left side (the seam; the glue flap stays unprinted). Set each layer's position, scale and “Extend to bottom” in the Dieline view.
layout.kept: Artwork of the other layouts ({{layouts}}) is kept and comes back when you switch the layout; it is not printed in this layout.
layout.sheetNote: A print-ready file: the artwork lies 1:1 on the whole dieline sheet (columns Left | Front | Right | Back | glue flap, bottom allowance included). Every wall shows its part of the sheet; the glue flap is not printed.

layers.title: Artwork layers
layers.orderNote: A layer higher in the list prints on top. The first layer (e.g. a background) fills the whole bag; further ones (logo, barcode…) start fitted to the front.
layers.empty: No layers yet — add the first artwork, e.g. a background.
layers.select: {{layer}}: {{name}} — select for editing on the dieline
layers.add: Add a layer — drop a file here
layers.addFirst: Add the first layer — drop a file here
layers.addFileInputLabel: File of the new artwork layer
layers.maxReached: The limit of {{max}} layers is reached — remove a layer to add another.
layers.orderNoteSheet: A layer higher in the list prints on top. The first layer (the whole-sheet file) fills the whole sheet; further ones start fitted to the front.

artwork.aspectMismatchSheet: The artwork's aspect ratio ({{imageRatio}}) differs from that of the dieline sheet ({{panelRatio}}) — with “Stretch” the artwork will be distorted and will not match the walls.

paper.label: Paper
paper.grammageRange: Range for the selected handle: {{min}}–{{max}} g/m², in steps of {{step}} g/m²
paper.weightNote: Blank paper ({{area}} m²) × grammage — without handles, patches and glue.

print.label: Print

errors.TOO_LONG: The code is too long (max. {{max}} characters).
errors.DUPLICATE: This colour is already on the list.
errors.LIMIT_REACHED: The limit of {{max}} colours has been reached.

print.previewNote: The preview colour approximates the Pantone ink on screen (RGB) — used for previews and the ink-coverage estimate.

swatches.title: Colour swatch library (.ase)
swatches.none: No library — Pantone preview colours are built-in approximations.
swatches.skipped: Skipped entries: {{value}} (unsupported colour model, malformed, unnamed, duplicate or over the limit).
swatches.approximate: CMYK colours ({{value}}) were converted for the screen approximately (no ICC profile).
swatches.notPersisted: This library could not be remembered in this browser (not enough space or storage unavailable) — it lasts until the tab is closed.
swatches.privacy: Use your own licensed colour library (e.g. an export from Pantone Connect). The library stays in this browser only — it is not uploaded, bundled with the app, or saved in the configuration and exports.

errors.TOO_LARGE: The file is too large (max {{max}} MB).
errors.NOT_ASE: This is not an Adobe Swatch Exchange (.ase) file.
errors.TRUNCATED: The .ase file is damaged or incomplete.
errors.NO_COLORS: The file contains no colours that can be imported.
errors.READ_FAILED: The file could not be read.
errors.TOO_MANY_LIBRARIES: At most {{maxLibraries}} libraries can be loaded — remove one to add another.
errors.TOO_MANY_COLORS: All libraries together can have at most {{maxColors}} colours — remove a library.

swatches.inLibrary: In the library “{{library}}”: {{name}} — the preview colour will be taken from the library.

errorsShort.DUPLICATE: This colour is already in the print colours.
errorsShort.LIMIT_REACHED: The limit of {{max}} print colours has been reached.
errorsShort.TOO_LONG: The colour name is too long for a Pantone code (max {{max}} characters).

swatches.multiNote: Several libraries can be loaded at once (max {{max}}, e.g. Coated and Uncoated); a file with the same name replaces the one loaded before. A code present in several libraries is taken from the one loaded first.

summary.label: Summary
summary.copyFailed: Could not copy — select the text manually.

preview.orbit: Orbit the bag: 360° around and from 45° above to 45° below

phase.FRONT_TRAPEZOID: C1: front trapezoid onto the bottom
phase.GUSSET_TUCK: A: gussets tucked in by the knives (F/2 each)
phase.GUSSET_WRAP: B: back wrapped over, seam closed (glued flap)
phase.GUSSET_BOTTOM: C: bottom strip d folded to the back (glued)

window.label: Window

description.PANORAMIC: Vertical strip in the middle of the front, from the bottom strip up to the mouth (open at the top).
description.RECTANGLE: Rectangular cut-out in the middle of the front, at a chosen height.

fieldInfo.width: the opening is always centred on the front; at least the film overlap + 5 mm of paper remain to the side edges.
fieldInfo.height: from the lower to the upper edge of the opening; at least the film overlap + 5 mm of paper remain up to the mouth.
fieldInfo.bottomOffset: from the bottom fold line (bottom edge of the finished bag) to the lower edge of the opening; minimum = bottom strip + film overlap + 5 mm.
fieldInfo.filmOverlap: how far the film (glued on the inside) overlaps the paper on every closed side of the opening.

geometry.PANORAMIC: Opening {{width}} × {{height}} mm from {{bottom}} mm above the bottom up to the mouth; film {{filmWidth}} × {{filmHeight}} mm.
geometry.RECTANGLE: Opening {{width}} × {{height}} mm, {{bottom}} mm above the bottom; film {{filmWidth}} × {{filmHeight}} mm.

window.artworkNote: Nothing is printed in the opening — the paper is cut out (the 3D preview, dieline and ink coverage take this into account).

warnings.WINDOW_LARGE_OPENING: The opening takes more than {{share}}% of the front print area — the front may be weaker. Check with production.
